metadata.scope_note: No Bhutan or Maldives entries are included; this is not a claim that no gurdwaras exist there.
metadata.coverage: Selected 300-entry directory, not all gurdwaras or all historic gurdwaras in South Asia.
metadata.count_unit: Distinct named shrine, institution, or explicitly flagged heritage site; not necessarily a distinct land parcel.
metadata.location_precision: Locality or town, with state/province and country; district where supplied. Not a verified full street address.
metadata.location_method: Source-listed locality, with standardized geographic labels. Modern districts and provinces may be normalized from older directories.
metadata.coordinates: Not geocoded; latitude and longitude intentionally null for every entry.
metadata.operating_status: Not verified for any entry; historical sources can describe former, closed, or altered sites.
metadata.selection_method: Editorial selection emphasizing recognized Takhts, prominent pilgrimage shrines, Guru-associated heritage, memorials, and geographic coverage.
metadata.historic_definition: Traditionally or institutionally recognized Sikh heritage shrine, Guru-associated place, or historic memorial. The tag does not date the current building.
metadata.null_historic_definition: Historic status unclassified in this compilation, including contemporary community institutions and entries without enough historical detail.
metadata.sources_policy: Institutional and government sources are preferred. Secondary directories are identified; a source reference is not independent verification of every statement on the linked page.
